title: swe-fix run summary
description: The final JSON object a swe-fix run must emit. Enforced with `claude -p --json-schema`; the 0..1 range on confidence is documented here and range-checked on the host because structured outputs do not support numeric minimum/maximum.

files_changed.description: Every repo-relative path listed by `git -C /testbed diff --name-only`.

tests_run.description: The exact commands that were run: the reproduction and the nearest existing tests.

reproduction.description: The reproduction script under /task/repro/ and whether it passes after the fix.

passes.description: True only if the script was seen to pass after the fix.

confidence.description: Honest estimate, from 0 to 1 inclusive, that the project's own hidden test for this issue passes.

blocked.description: True if the run stopped short of the done condition.

notes.description: Root cause in one sentence; anything unverified; any blocker.
